title: fix "Contexts in which this element can be used:" of <a>, <address>, <audio>, <video>, <dfn>, <form>, <label>, <meter> and <progress> element
body:
a element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/text-level-semantics.html#the-a-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected, **but with no ancestor a elements**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/text-level-semantics.html#the-a-element
> Content model:
> - Transparent, but there must be no interactive content or **a element** descendants.

　
　

address element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/sections.html#the-address-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where flow content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where flow content is expected, **but with no ancestor address elements**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/sections.html#the-address-element
> Content model:
> - Flow content, but with no heading content descendants, no sectioning content descendants, and no header, footer, or **address** element descendants.

　
　

audio and video element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#the-audio-element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#the-video-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where embedded content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where embedded content is expected, **but with no media element ancestors**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#the-audio-element
Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#the-video-element
> Content model:
> - If the element has a src attribute: zero or more track elements, then transparent, but with no **media element** descendants.
> - If the element does not have a src attribute: zero or more source elements, then zero or more track elements, then transparent, but with no **media element** descendants.

　
　

dfn element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/text-level-semantics.html#the-dfn-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected, **but with no ancestor dfn elements**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/text-level-semantics.html#the-dfn-element
> Content model:
> - Phrasing content, but there must be no **dfn** element descendants.

　
　

form element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-form-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where flow content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where flow content is expected, **but with no ancestor form elements**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-form-element
> Content model:
> - Flow content, but with no **form** element descendants.

　
　

label element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-label-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected, **but with no ancestor label elements**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/forms.html#the-label-element
> Content model:
> - Phrasing content, but with no descendant labelable elements unless it is the element's labeled control, and no descendant **label** elements.

　
　

meter element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-meter-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected, **but with no ancestor meter elements**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-meter-element
> Content model:
> - Phrasing content, but there must be no **meter** element descendants.

　
　

progress element
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-progress-element
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected.

↓
The above should be fixed following;
> Contexts in which this element can be used:
> - Where phrasing content is expected, **but with no ancestor progress elements**.

Ref: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-progress-element
> Content model:
> - Phrasing content, but there must be no **progress** element descendants.
